summary: ansible-vault edit decrypts a file to a temp file for editing, then re-encrypts and removes the temp file; a vault ID can be passed.
questions: How do I edit a vault-encrypted file in place?
Does ansible-vault edit leave a decrypted copy on disk?
How do I edit a file encrypted with a specific vault ID?

answer_card.title: Edit an encrypted file
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-vault edit foo.yml
ansible-vault edit --vault-id pass2@vault2 foo.yml
```

It decrypts to a temporary file, opens your editor, then re-encrypts and removes the temp file when you close the editor.
